name: Silver tide / an authored moving surface
art: Use the original encoded films under site/assets/motion/films/ and matched posters, or reproduce them with the linked shader/export pipeline. The authored wave function has a 16-second analytic period; omit the duplicate final frame when exporting.

properties.label: Meditative horizon over moving water
properties.text: Fill the page with a wide dark sea beneath a sparse meditative heading. Preserve a coherent low horizon and quiet upper reading area, balanced by a small right note and bottom light and pace controls.

properties.label: Layered reflective dark water
properties.text: Layer long swells and finer ripples into one continuous blue-black water surface with sharp silver reflection fragments and darker troughs. Avoid large blurry sine bumps.

properties.label: Silver and amber horizon light
properties.text: Use cool silver specular fragments by default; the Afterglow state adds warm amber light while preserving the same wave structure and horizon.

properties.label: Deterministic 16-second tide loop
properties.text: Use a deterministic authored 16-second wave loop with intentional hover or explicit playback. Pace changes playback rate; Silver and Afterglow select matched films. Pause on hover leave and hidden tabs, and keep keyboard playback available.

properties.label: Deferred film and poster delivery
properties.text: Defer video bytes until needed. Reduced motion and Save-Data retain selectable matching posters. The films come from the original shader and remain inspectable through the source capture route.

properties.label: Wave film continuity check
properties.text: Compare wave detail, horizon, specular shape and the loop boundary. Confirm source changes never show a stale frame and that no video downloads before needed.
